newsitem.title: GERMANY: Vargas Llosa calls for end to dictatorship in Cuba.
newsitem.headline: Vargas Llosa calls for end to dictatorship in Cuba.

text.p: Novelist Mario Vargas Llosa said on Saturday the time had come for a peaceful end to dictatorship in Cuba.

Speaking at a press conference at the Frankfurt Book Fair, where he is to be awarded the German book industry's prestigious Peace Prize, Vargas Llosa said: "I know Cuba very well. The majority of the Cuban people long for democracy".
Vargas Llosa, who lost a bid for the Peruvian presidency in 1990, said he very much hoped that there would be an end to the suffering of the Cuban people.
The international community should help to speed up the process in the same way it helped the South African people to gain their freedom.
"The time has come for a peaceful end to the dictatorship in Cuba," he said.
